submittedPrompt: 制作source-derived笔记关系图整页。完整主人知识图谱桌面页，约1440×1000。实际图1决定图谱宿主，图2只给共享平面配色密度，绝不借笔记owner rail/目录树。窄专属图谱rail顶部返回、知识图谱/笔记图谱/关系审核/后台分析/图谱问答/视图与导出，底部模型设置；页头现有返回、知识图谱、让资料中的联系清晰可见、分析模式badge、右侧后台分析状态入口。工具栏按序知识/笔记分段、搜索图谱输入placeholder搜索概念、实体或笔记及搜索图标、筛选、画布/列表分段。现有图谱问答只是入口，不画聊天窗口，不新增自动分析/自动配置模型。rail笔记图谱选中；页头仍源码标题知识图谱，模式基础分析，状态基础分析就绪。类型笔记选中、画布选中，搜索输入当前“不存在的笔记”，有既有清除图标与搜索图标。该查询无匹配，摘要0个节点、0条关系与刷新。大白画布没有任何节点/关系，中间准确空提示“暂无匹配内容，可调整搜索或筛选条件。”；画布底部保留+/−/适应画布及原图例笔记/概念/人物/组织/地点/事件/技术、虚线表示候选或相似线索。未选中笔记，无详情/1跳2跳/打开原文按钮，这些只在真实选中态出现；不新增关系、不混进知识实体数据或任务/问答/模型弹窗。统一平面白/浅灰、#272b3a正文、#657084次级、#e6e9f1细线、#4566c6蓝色、#edf1ff选中，清晰紧凑中文无衬线、8px圆角。无纹理渐变、浏览器外壳、开发说明或协议字段输入。synthetic query/source-derived/未runtime状态仅metadata。

sourceContracts.title: Note reference graph mode

entry.trigger: 笔记 graph-type segment or hosted 笔记图谱 navigation

permissionRules: Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.
Explore uses webPrincipal plus authenticated ownerId; knowledge/graph service filters authorized current source evidence. Export is limited to current visible result.
Graph rejects share principals. Graph control/state/command management requires principal.id=web-owner; evidence/explore scope follows sourceAccess authorization (analysis-source.ts:31).

fields.name: 图谱类型
fields.constraints: Existing notes view of graph; returns to knowledge view with other segment.

actions.label: 笔记 / 知识
actions.effect: Change current graph query view and refresh authorized graph.
actions.guard: Current graph request/navigation and busy guards apply.

actions.label: 选择笔记 / 1跳 / 2跳 / 打开原文
actions.effect: Inspect note reference relationships, focus neighborhood or open note.

responsive.behavior: At <800px JS uses a details drawer; <=799px CSS stacks search and form columns, single-column graph body; desktop shows inspector beside canvas. GraphOverlay width min(requested,100vw-24px), drawer <=100vw and body scrolls (apps/web/graph.css:394; components/graph/GraphOverlay.vue:36).

sourceContracts.designReason: Existing user-visible surface requires baseline-aligned hierarchy, controls, feedback and responsive treatment without adding behavior.
notes: Source inventory only; no runtime behavior asserted.
Same graph page and route; this state is not counted as an extra page.

postprocessing: Original built-in PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits.

selfInspection.method: Actual native generated PNG viewed against all input images and exact source template/conditional state contracts.
concerns: Static raster is not proof of executed actions, owner/recipient permissions, focus/keyboard, guard enforcement, canvas topology or responsive fit.
Light raster shading and approximate geometry are illustrative; exact source labels and shared flat CSS tokens remain implementation requirements.
Source-derived selected component/state; actual matching runtime capture is unavailable. Supplied actual screenshot is only parent/host reference where present.
Synthetic no-match note query intentionally avoids fabricated reference edges; selected inspector/open-source/hop actions are conditional and absent.
